verdict.rationale: The evidence covers only the front half of the story. Employees can capture and submit expenses via SmartScan receipt scanning and create expenses in plain language, and those expenses can be approved or rejected. Nothing in the pack documents reimbursement payouts, direct deposit, payout speed, or status tracking from submission to payment. missing for 10: documented employee reimbursement via direct deposit, evidence of payout in days, submission-to-payout status tracking, independent corroboration of the reimbursement flow.
